english_translation: I am pregnant and have been feeling abdominal pain; should I visit the clinic for an examination?
grammar_notes: Concordial Agreement (Zvivakashure): Notice how 'ndakazvitakura' establishes the noun class/subject frame (1st Person Sg Past Concord (ndaka-)).
Agglutinative Morphology: 'ndibatsirike' combines prefixal/suffixal morphemes (Ø- (Cl. 5/9) + -ndibatsirike (root)) with tone contour H-L-H-L.
Penultimate Lengthening: In Zezuru declarative sentences, the second-to-last syllable of the phrase carries natural vowel lengthening.
cultural_notes: In Harare Zezuru standard speech, speakers maintain strict alliterative concord (zvivakashure) across noun classes while using respectful plural forms (hunhu).
